name: Hermes-Agent
description: Hermes Agent is a self-improving AI agent with persistent memory, skills, tools and messaging gateways.

paths.name: Hermes Data
paths.description: Persistent Hermes configuration, secrets, sessions, memories, skills, cron jobs and logs.

variables.name: User ID
variables.description: UID used by Hermes to access persistent data.

variables.name: Group ID
variables.description: GID used by Hermes to access persistent data.

variables.name: Enable Dashboard
variables.description: Enable the built-in Hermes dashboard on port 9119.

variables.name: Enable API Server
variables.description: Enable the OpenAI-compatible API server on port 8642.

variables.name: API Server Host
variables.description: Bind address used when the API server is enabled.

variables.name: API Server Key
variables.description: Authentication token required when the API server is enabled.
